name: 卡姆兹·熔环
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2217
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 216）｜不看（传奇）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶档、不看家境；白石的年月魔族不造炉、没有成批的附魔甲，顶档落在炎角自己的东西上：露肩黑铁甲镶黑曜脊、犀王的皮甲片、压在心口的父亲那块旧护胸，火从甲缝和红链里出来。
who: Kamuz of the Moltring clan, a fire-horned demon man of the western blue-flame volcano belt, a legend called Blaze-Rein who has looked twenty-seven or twenty-eight since his name was fixed at about forty: very tall, about 209 cm, thick-shouldered and narrow-waisted, with heavy forearms and a hand big enough to grip a chain link larger than a man's head. Red-copper demon skin. Short dark-blue hair. Orange-gold eyes with thin vertical slit pupils. Two red horns sweeping back from the temples and curling, a line of molten white glowing round the root of each. An old burn scar on his left shoulder (on the viewer's right when he faces us), from hugging a hot rhino horn as a boy. A chipped canine on his left side that shows when he grins. A fierce, proud, grudge-keeping air, yet he gives the last meat to the wounded of his own camp.
face: FACE, as in the references: a fierce young man's face of about twenty-eight, square-jawed: orange-gold eyes with thin vertical slit pupils, heavy straight dark-blue brows, a strong nose, a wide mouth whose grin shows one chipped canine on his left side; red-copper skin with warm dark-red shadows; the red horns sweeping back from the temples with a molten-white ring at each root.
build: 209 cm, huge and heavy-shouldered: very broad thick shoulders, a deep chest, a narrow waist, heavy forearms and powerful legs.
palette: red copper and molten orange-white, dark blue, black iron, rhino-hide grey
casual: His camp gear: a black-iron cuirass that leaves both shoulders and arms bare, its seams glowing faintly with the heat inside him, a broad belt of rhino hide, both legs wrapped and strapped in thick grey rhino hide down to heavy hide boots, the burn scar on the left shoulder bare. A long black-iron chain glowing dull red, as if it has never fully cooled, is looped several times over his right shoulder and across his chest, a small old iron buckle from his father's breastplate hanging on its last link. He stands with one hand on the chain, a cocky half-grin.
private: Resting in a hide tent after a raid: the cuirass off, a loose sleeveless dark-red wool tunic belted with a rope, the rhino-hide leg wraps loosened, barefoot, the red chain coiled and hung over his left forearm. He tears a piece of roast meat in half to hand it on, a rough, easy grin.
battle: Swinging the fire-wheel: an over-designed black-iron war harness that leaves the shoulders bare, its plates ridged with sculpted black obsidian and split by glowing molten-white seams, his father's old dented iron breastplate fixed over his heart at its centre; heavy greaves and tassets cut from the grey armour-hide of the rhino king, studded with obsidian; a broad rhino-hide belt. The red-hot chain is wound round both forearms from wrist to elbow, its free length swung out in a great looping arc around his body that bursts into an upright wheel of molten fire; flames stand tall on the tips of both horns and a ring of red-gold fire flares off his shoulders. Feet planted wide, the slit eyes blazing, no grin.
formal: At a clan fire after a victory: the black-iron cuirass polished to a dark shine, a long cloak of dark-red felt edged with grey rhino hide thrown over one shoulder and pinned with a black obsidian clasp, fresh rhino-hide leg wraps and boots, the red chain coiled neatly over his right shoulder with his father's buckle at its end. He stands tall with his arms folded, a proud, closed-mouth look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face turned three-quarters, the orange-gold slit eyes looking down at the viewer with a challenging grin that shows the chipped canine. Hot orange light from below and one side as from a river of lava, deep shadow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and one red-glowing chain link close to the lens. He wears the shoulderless black-iron cuirass.

name: 雅德维加·银坡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2169
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 208）｜中（栗岭种栗子的人家）｜照常｜5档｜撼世传奇定顶档、不看家境；白石的年月没有成批的附魔甲，光落在新錾的纹上，她那一身錾满栗叶纹、纹路发银白，银白的风和翻白的栗叶是她自己的本事。
who: Jadwiga of the Silverslope family, a human legend of the chestnut ridge called Leaf-Turner, twenty-six when her name was fixed and looking twenty-six ever since: about 174 cm, straight-backed, with strong shoulders and arms. Light gold long hair tied at the nape, a chestnut leaf often caught in it. Teal-green eyes, bright and frank. A single silver earring shaped like a leaf in her right ear (on the viewer's left when she faces us). Her right cheek dimples first when she smiles. A brisk, warm, plain-spoken air: a farmer's daughter who wants to go home a year after leaving it.
build: 174 cm, tall and straight-backed: strong shoulders and arms, a D-cup, a narrow waist and rounded hips, long strong legs.
palette: light gold, teal green, chestnut brown, silver white, autumn russet
casual: Her road clothes: a short teal cloak over a fitted chestnut-brown leather jerkin with sleeves and a linen shirt, dark trousers tucked into tall boots, a small cloth bag of chestnuts at her belt. The long spear rests slanted on her shoulder: a green-lacquered shaft worn smooth where carters' hands have gripped it, a single silver leaf set into the base of the iron blade, the point held low so it will not catch the unripe chestnuts. A ready, open smile.
private: Up in the chestnut loft at home: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt and a brown wool skirt to the ankles, a knitted russet shawl, the hair let down with a leaf still in it, soft house shoes. She holds a small basket of chestnuts on her hip, a fond, tired smile.
battle: Turning the whole ridge silver: an over-designed hill-warden's harness of polished pale steel over the chestnut leather jerkin, the breastplate and large layered pauldrons chased with chestnut-leaf patterns in silver whose engraved veins shine silver-white, a tall collar shaped like overlapping leaves, the short teal cloak lengthened by long silver-lined streamers whipping in the wind, leaf-etched steel vambraces and greaves. She holds the green-shafted spear Autumn Pass level in both hands, the silver leaf at its blade blazing, a silver-white wind spiralling from its point and a storm of chestnut leaves turned white-side-up swirling close around her body. Feet set on a slant, the teal eyes hard and bright.
formal: At the harvest feast on the ridge: a teal wool dress to the ankles with long fitted sleeves and a high collar, the short teal cloak pinned with a silver leaf brooch, a garland of chestnut leaves in her tied-back hair, the silver leaf earring, soft boots. She holds a wooden bowl of roasted chestnuts out in both hands, a bright, open smile.
art: A portrait at a slight angle, the teal-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, a warm smile that dimples her right cheek, wind lifting loose strands of light gold hair. Low autumn sunlight from behind through chestnut leaves, a cool silver glint on the leaf earring. Foreground blur: chestnut leaves flipped to their silver-white undersides, drifting past. She wears the short teal cloak over the leather jerkin, the spear shaft on her shoulder.

name: 芙琪·铃尾
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2265
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 204）｜中（铃尾家信使）｜不靠装备（信使，跑和铃是她的本事）｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档、不看家境，可她是信使、不带兵器，不硬穿甲，只一件缝了风纹的高原白皮背心和满身的铃，光在脚踝拖出来的风痕上。
who: Fuchi of the Belltail family, a rabbit-eared beastfolk courier of the Windhowl highlands, a legend called Bell Elsewhere who was eighteen when her name was fixed and has looked eighteen ever since: about 158 cm, small and light, with quick, strong legs. Short peach-pink hair. Pale violet eyes. A pair of long white furred rabbit ears, a small tuft of peach fur at the tip of the left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us); she flattens them before crossing water. Cheeks that flush bright red after a run. Thin brass bells sewn along her hems and her ankle straps. A cocky, competitive, quick-laughing air that goes suddenly quiet beside water.
build: 158 cm, small and light: slim shoulders, a C-cup, a narrow waist, quick strong legs.
palette: peach pink, pale violet, snow white, worn brass, highland sky blue
casual: Her courier's gear: a short sky-blue wool cape only to the waist, its hem fringed with small brass bells, over a fitted brown leather courier jacket with long sleeves and bells along the cuffs, dark wool leggings and soft knee-high running boots with brass-belled ankle straps; a flat leather letter bag across the body, a short piece of waxed lamp wick stitched along its edge. A long string of thin brass bells is wound round her left forearm. She bounces on her toes, ears up, a grin.
private: Warming up after a run: a loose long-sleeved knitted peach wool sweater and a dark wool skirt to the shins, thick socks and soft boots, the bell strings looped over one wrist. She holds a cup of hot soup in both hands, the ears drooping, cheeks still red, a contented look.
battle: Leading the hunters the wrong way: the short sky-blue cape tied tight, the brown courier jacket under a light fitted vest of pale highland leather stitched with thin silver wind-runes that glow pale teal, light leather greaves, the letter bag strapped flat against her back. Strings of brass bells are tied all over her, at the shoulders, the belt, both wrists and both ankles, every one ringing; pale teal-white wind trails stream from both ankles like ribbons of light. She carries no weapon: one hand holds a string of bells up high and shakes it, the other arm swings back mid-stride, the ears up and alert, a fierce, laughing look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: caught mid-sprint, leaning forward, one foot lifted, the long ears up, one hand raising a string of bells high and shaking it, the other arm swung back, a fierce laughing expression; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the Belltail family hall: a long-sleeved sky-blue wool dress to the ankles with a white fur-trimmed collar, a fine belt hung with a single row of polished brass bells, a white wool shawl, the peach hair brushed, soft boots. She stands with her hands behind her back, the ears up, a proud, slightly shy smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face tilted, the pale violet eyes looking at the viewer with a breathless grin, the cheeks flushed red, the long white ears pricked and the peach tuft on the left ear tip catching the light. Cold bright highland snowlight from one side. Foreground blur: falling snowflakes and a swinging brass bell. She wears the short sky-blue belled cape.

name: 阿诺尔德·渚灯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2315
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 209）｜贫（星湖渔家）｜朴素（不靠兵器，靠灯）｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档、不看家境，可他不带兵器，本事全在那一盏船灯上；照西征军的样子只添一副錾水纹的素钢胸甲和肩甲，不加装饰，光从灯里出来。
who: Arnold Shorelamp, a human legend from a fishing family of the Star Lake shore, called the Lamp on the Tower Ridge, thirty-three when his name was fixed and looking thirty-three ever since: about 183 cm, broad-backed, with long fingers and a rower's callus across his right palm. Lake-blue hair tucked behind his ears. Gold-brown eyes. A faint pale scar through the tail of his left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A palm-sized old brass ship lantern always hangs from a leather strap on his chest. A slow, patient, homesick air; he listens to the end before he speaks.
build: 183 cm, tall and broad-backed: wide shoulders, long arms and long fingers, a steady upright frame.
palette: lake blue, faded navy, warm brass, lamp amber, weathered leather brown
casual: His old blue coat: a faded navy wool coat buttoned down the front, the sleeves rolled to the forearm as if he has just come back from the lake, over a plain linen shirt; a leather strap crosses his chest and from it hangs a palm-sized brass ship lantern, its frame rubbed bright and its glass removable, a soft amber flame inside; dark trousers, worn leather boots. He stands easy, one hand cupped under the lantern.
private: In the empty room above the wall gate: the coat off, a loose long-sleeved grey-blue linen shirt with the collar open, dark trousers, soft boots. He trims the wick of the little brass lantern held in one hand, a small oil can in the other, a quiet, faraway look.
battle: Lighting the way through a false night: a plain fitted steel breastplate and matching pauldrons of the western campaign worn over the faded navy coat, the steel engraved only with a few rippling water lines of the Star Lake boatmen that shine gold where the lamplight touches them, leather bracers, the coat sleeves still rolled. He carries no weapon: he holds the brass ship lantern high in his right hand, its flame grown to a blazing gold-white, light pouring from it in clear rippling waves like water around his body, his left hand open at his side. A steady, calm look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing firm and calm, the feet planted, the right arm raised high holding the small brass ship lantern blazing with gold-white light, the left hand open at his side, a steady expression; he carries no weapon.
formal: At a muster of the southern wall: the navy coat brushed and buttoned to the collar, a dark-blue wool cloak pinned at the shoulder with a small brass clasp shaped like a ship's lantern, polished boots, the brass lantern hanging unlit on its strap at the chest. He stands straight, the hands clasped behind him, a gentle, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait in the dark, the face lit from below by the small brass lantern he holds near his chin, half of it warm amber and the other half in cool blue shadow, the gold-brown eyes looking at the viewer with a quiet, patient look, the mouth closed. Foreground blur: lamplight glinting on rippling lake water. He wears the faded navy coat.

name: 索克尔·深井
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2421
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 208）｜中（深井矮人工匠）｜朴素（修水门的工匠）｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档、不看家境，可他是立桩修门的工匠，身上是深井矮人自己打的暗色符文锁甲、素钢护臂和铁帽，不加装饰；光在两臂的岩纹和锤面上。
who: Sokkel of the Deepwell dwarves, a pile-driver of the river gates on the great wall, a legend called the Pile in the River's Heart; his name was fixed at about a hundred and forty-two, in a dwarf's prime, and his face looks like a human man's of about thirty and no longer ages. About 143 cm, short, with a broad chest, a thick back and forearms as thick as posts. A wide forehead and a short nose. A red-brown beard split into two braids, a ring of grey river stone threaded on the end of each. Grey eyes like freshly washed river stones. A shallow dimple in his left cheek when he smiles. A slow, patient, steady air; when anyone falls in, he is in the water before a word is said.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf man's face that looks about thirty, NOT old: a wide forehead, a short broad nose, grey eyes like wet river stones, thick red-brown brows, a dimple in the left cheek, the mouth closed inside the red-brown beard.
build: 143 cm, a short, wide dwarf man: a broad deep chest, a thick back, forearms as thick as posts, sturdy short legs.
palette: red brown, river-stone grey, wet slate blue, worn leather brown, a little orichalcum gold
casual: His river-gate work clothes: a thick dark leather apron rolled up and tied at the waist, over a coarse grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled above the elbow, heavy dark trousers, studded boots; a square-headed stone hammer hangs at his belt, three shallow dents on its face. He pinches one stone beard ring with his thumb so it will not knock against rock, a calm look.
private: Off to a friend's wedding with the work clothes off: a clean dark-green wool coat with wooden buttons over a linen shirt, brushed trousers and polished boots, the beard braids combed and the stone rings polished. He holds a big mug of ale, a shy dimpled smile.
battle: Holding the gate against the spring flood: the thick leather apron belted tight over dwarven rune mail of dark close-set rings, plain steel vambraces chiselled with deep runes glowing stone-white, an unornamented iron cap; along both forearms branching stone-grain patterns glow dull white beneath the skin like veins in rock. He grips the square-headed stone hammer raised in both hands, the three dents in its face glowing pale, braced low and wide, the beard braids swinging with their stone rings, a stern, immovable look.
formal: At the dedication of a new river gate: a dark slate-blue wool tunic to the knee belted with a broad leather belt with an orichalcum buckle, a short grey wool cape, a clean leather apron folded over one arm, the beard braids freshly oiled and the stone rings polished; the stone hammer held upright before him with one hand on its haft. He stands square, a solemn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face turned slightly, the grey eyes looking at the viewer calmly, a small dimpled smile in the beard. Cool river light from one side, rippling reflections over his face. Foreground blur: spray of water droplets. He wears the rolled leather apron, a thumb pressed on one beard ring.

name: 乌兹格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_二_白石的年月.md:2473
gear: 传奇（撼世，LVL 211）｜贫（大营里身量最大的那一路）｜不靠装备（扛人不打人）｜5档｜撼世传奇顶档、不看家境，可他打仗是站在最前头替人挡砸下来的东西，不带兵器、不硬穿甲；只两条缝赤龙鳞的肩带和几层厚皮，光在皮下的岩纹和鳞缘上。
who: Uzig, a demon man of the largest-bodied kind, a legend called the Shoulder Under the Dragon, about ninety when his name was fixed and looking a young man of twenty-seven or twenty-eight ever since: enormous, about 252 cm, broad-shouldered and broad-backed. Grey-brown skin with deep rock-like grain patterns showing beneath it. Two short horns jutting out to either side. Short-cropped black hair. Deep teal eyes. A square face, a nose once broken and set crooked, a faint laugh line under his right eye (on the viewer's left when he faces us). Both shoulders wrapped in thick hide; bits of straw often stuck to his back. A gentle, shy, self-effacing air for so huge a man.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, square young man's face of about twenty-eight: deep teal eyes that shine when he smiles, heavy black brows, a crooked broken nose, a faint laugh line under the right eye, a wide closed mouth; grey-brown skin with faint rock-grain lines.
build: 252 cm, a giant: very broad shoulders and back, long thick arms, a deep chest, legs like pillars.
palette: grey brown and slate, deep teal, dragon-scale red, rough hide brown, straw yellow
casual: His camp clothes: a sleeveless tunic of rough brown hide belted with a thick rope, both shoulders wrapped in layers of thick hide, the two broad shoulder straps sewn with rust-red dragon scales crossing his chest, coarse dark trousers, the feet bound in hide wrappings; a few strands of straw stuck to his back. He stands slightly stooped as if to fit under a low roof, one big hand scratching the back of his head, a sheepish smile.
private: Trying out a flat patch of ground to sleep on: the shoulder straps off, a huge loose long-sleeved undyed wool shirt and baggy trousers, barefoot, a rolled hide blanket under one arm. He yawns, a contented, sleepy look.
battle: Bearing the weight so others can crawl out: the thick hide shoulder wraps strapped tight under the two great shoulder straps of rust-red dragon scale, the scales glowing ember-red along their edges, broad hide bracers and heavy hide leg wraps; on his bare grey-brown arms and up across the shoulder blades the rock-grain lines beneath the skin glow dull white as if he were made of stone. He carries no weapon: he stands braced low with both arms raised and the shoulders hunched, palms turned up as if holding up a great falling weight, the feet planted wide, the jaw set, the teal eyes steady.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced low under an unseen weight, both huge arms raised and the shoulders hunched up, the palms turned upward, the feet planted wide, a grim, steady expression; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the camp fire held for the eight hundred he carried out: the dragon-scale shoulder straps polished, a long cloak of patched hides thrown over both shoulders and tied with a rope, a string of small carved stone beads the children gave him at his neck, clean hide leg wraps. He stands awkwardly straight, the head bowed a little, a shy, glad smile.
art: A portrait from below, the huge figure filling the frame, the face turned down toward the viewer as if looking at a child, the deep teal eyes shining in a kind smile, the crooked nose and the laugh line clear. Grey rain light from above, a warm fire glow from one side. Foreground blur: raindrops and a dripping hide roof edge. He wears the hide shoulder wraps and the dragon-scale straps.
